name: At the Mythic Markets
source:
There’s something fishy going on at the mythic markets. You are a member of the witches' council, and you’ve heard rumours of a dark creature that’s up for sale at ‘the market’.  The cheerful salesman, Cassian, approaches you and seems to know more than he’s letting on. The question is…do you think people deserve a second chance, no matter where they’re from?

[From [url=https://seraten04.itch.io/at-the-mythic-markets]itch.io[/url]]
